title: Advancement Saver
description: Saves and restores player advancements reliably on Paper 26.2 for servers which don't save advancements.
body:
This project was created because my PaperMC server wouldn't save the advancements. I kept trying to fix the problem but just couldn't find it, so I thought, why not just create my own plugin that saves the advancements for me? I made the plugin with a lot of testing and improvement. The plugin might be really lightweight, but it sure does a lot.

Before downloading this plugin, check the advancements block of you spigot.yml and make sure the disable saving line looks exactly like

disable-saving: false

is the disable saving is true, thats the reason advancements weren't saving.
